name: API explorer
description: The HTTP endpoints your code declares, grouped by path with their files, and a panel that sends a request to your running server.

commands.name: endpoints
commands.description: Every endpoint found in the code: method, path, file and line.

commands.description: Send a request to the base address set for the tile and answer with the status, headers, body and time taken.
commands.args: { "method": string, "path": string, "body"?: string or JSON (sent as application/json) }

settings.label: Base address
settings.description: Where your server answers; requests go to this address plus the path.

tools.label: API explorer
tools.description: The code's HTTP endpoints, and requests to try them.
